What these values mean: reference gold measures what the stats cost using the selected shop benchmarks. It is not a fair-price verdict. Immunity, crowd control, army coverage, uptime and fitting more benefits into one inventory slot can be worth much more than the raw stats. The additional starting amulet is included as a free recipe ingredient.

Two important assumptions: armor uses (225g − 4 STR × 27.5g) ÷ 5 = 23g per armor. Medaillon of Glim implies 12.5g per armor instead, so this is a selected benchmark, not a universal market law. Sobi’s +50 mana is worth 50g, leaving 50g for +125% regeneration: 0.4g per percentage point.

Frosty example: 150 damage × 13g = 1,950g; 20% attack speed × 13.75g = 275g; 50% self-only lifesteal × 7.5g = 375g. Expanded subtotal: 2,600g. Its frost effects remain unpriced. That does not establish that 4,500g is balanced for a hero with native cleave.

Do not double-count attributes: STR, AGI and INT already include their inherent benefits in their benchmark. Only separately attached HP, mana, armor, attack speed and damage bonuses are added.

  • v44: all six audited cleaving heroes use 250 area at every rank, matching base-game Cleaving Attack. Pit Lord and Crazy Cat share ANca. Myrmidon now matches Pit Lord and Crazy Cat at 30/40/50/60/70/80%. Demon Knight and Mundo use 40/50/60%.
  • Yeti Transformation is native Avatar (A0B5): 50 seconds, 220-second cooldown; +500/750/1000 HP, +5/10/15 armor and +30/40/50 damage. This is an important durability pairing with its native cleave.
  • Blooddancer (O00G) has Pulverize A0C6: 25% proc chance, 100/125/150/200/275/300 fixed damage; full area 250/275/300/350/350/350 and half-damage area 300/325/400/400/450/500. It is attack-triggered area damage, not percentage cleave; raw attack damage does not enter its fixed damage field.
  • Demon Hunter/Fox transformed forms use missile splash rather than ANca. They are a separate attack-area family; they should not be treated as proof of melee-cleave or melee-lifesteal compatibility.
  • Tusk adds a separate A07G native cleave (60%, area 200). No item-specific combination script changes the above native cleave fields. Source data alone does not prove the engine’s cleave stacking or lifesteal-on-secondary-target behavior; those require a live test.
  • Crazy Cat is explicitly prohibited from carrying Amulet of the Wind (I04A) by the pickup-limit script; do not assume every problematic item is available to every cleaver.

Balance implication: Myrmidon’s 190% cleave is a materially different damage multiplier from 80% cleave. Yeti covers a larger maximum area. Demon Knight and Mundo combine cleave with scripted spell immunity and attack speed. Evaluate item changes against these different kits instead of treating all melee heroes equally.

Effects, restrictions and script findings

  • Only the generated hero can purchase in its own team build area.
  • One ability per Z/X/C/V slot; occupied slot rejects further purchases.
  • Each ability can be learned only once per team.
  • Only one Z AoE ability per team.

  • Build closes after 45 seconds and all 32 shops are removed.

  • No explicit UnitMakeAbilityPermanent call is present in the purchase handler.
  • Shops use n000 and retain its 11 static items while adding 12 tokens. Actual command-card visibility of all added stock requires game verification.
  • Icon: this map inherits the Greater Mana Potion shop icon for this spell token. Its spell artwork is assigned to the model field (ifil), not the icon field (iico); the wiki displays the actual item icon.

Effects, restrictions and script findings

  • Only the generated hero can purchase in its own team build area.
  • One ability per Z/X/C/V slot; occupied slot rejects further purchases.
  • Each ability can be learned only once per team.
  • Only one Z AoE ability per team.
  • Successful purchase adds level-1 ability and removes token; denied purchases refund configured price and restock token.

  • Shops use n000 and retain its 11 static items while adding 12 tokens. Actual command-card visibility of all added stock requires game verification.
  • Icon: this map inherits the Greater Mana Potion shop icon for this spell token. Its spell artwork is assigned to the model field (ifil), not the icon field (iico); the wiki displays the actual item icon.

Effects, restrictions and script findings

  • Only the generated hero can purchase in its own team build area.
  • One ability per Z/X/C/V slot; occupied slot rejects further purchases.
  • Each ability can be learned only once per team.
  • Only one Z AoE ability per team.
  • Successful purchase adds level-1 ability and removes token; denied purchases refund configured price and restock token.
  • Build closes after 45 seconds and all 32 shops are removed.

  • Shops use n000 and retain its 11 static items while adding 12 tokens. Actual command-card visibility of all added stock requires game verification.
  • Icon: this map inherits the Greater Mana Potion shop icon for this spell token. Its spell artwork is assigned to the model field (ifil), not the icon field (iico); the wiki displays the actual item icon.

  • Consumable, spell purchase or information entry: purchase funds its effect/access; no permanent held-stat valuation.

Casting Time: 1; Duration - Normal: 0; Duration - Hero: 0; Cooldown: 8.0; Mana Cost: 125; Area of Effect: 200; Cast Range: 800; Number of Waves: 5; Damage: 33.0; Number of Shards: 5; Building Reduction: 0.1; Damage Per Second: 0; Maximum Damage per Wave: 99999.0.

No permanent carried stats are priced by this model. This item’s purchase buys its active effect, summon, spell access or information entry; zero stat subtotal does not mean zero gameplay value.

Core stats0gExpanded reference value0gUnallocated gold500gExpanded value / cost0%

Effects, restrictions and script findings

  • Only the generated hero can purchase in its own team build area.
  • One ability per Z/X/C/V slot; occupied slot rejects further purchases.
  • Each ability can be learned only once per team.
  • Only one Z AoE ability per team.
  • Successful purchase adds level-1 ability and removes token; denied purchases refund configured price and restock token.
  • Build closes after 45 seconds and all 32 shops are removed.
  • No script to upgrade purchased ability levels or free/reassign slots was found. UnitAddAbility does not itself make purchased spells part of the hero skill-learning list.
  • No explicit UnitMakeAbilityPermanent call is present in the purchase handler.
  • Shops use n000 and retain its 11 static items while adding 12 tokens. Actual command-card visibility of all added stock requires game verification.
  • Icon: this map inherits the Greater Mana Potion shop icon for this spell token. Its spell artwork is assigned to the model field (ifil), not the icon field (iico); the wiki displays the actual item icon.

What the valuation does not fully price

  • Consumable, spell purchase or information entry: purchase funds its effect/access; no permanent held-stat valuation.

650gpurchase cost

Teaches Avatar (AHav) at level 1 in slot V. Casting Time: 0; Duration - Normal: 45.0; Duration - Hero: 45.0; Cooldown: 240.0; Mana Cost: 150; Area of Effect: 0.5; Defense Bonus: 5; Hit Point Bonus: 500; Damage Bonus: 30.0; Magic Damage Reduction: 0.

No permanent carried stats are priced by this model. This item’s purchase buys its active effect, summon, spell access or information entry; zero stat subtotal does not mean zero gameplay value.

Core stats0gExpanded reference value0gUnallocated gold650gExpanded value / cost0%

Effects, restrictions and script findings

  • Only the generated hero can purchase in its own team build area.
  • One ability per Z/X/C/V slot; occupied slot rejects further purchases.
  • Each ability can be learned only once per team.
  • Only one Z AoE ability per team.
  • Successful purchase adds level-1 ability and removes token; denied purchases refund configured price and restock token.
  • Build closes after 45 seconds and all 32 shops are removed.
  • No script to upgrade purchased ability levels or free/reassign slots was found. UnitAddAbility does not itself make purchased spells part of the hero skill-learning list.
  • No explicit UnitMakeAbilityPermanent call is present in the purchase handler.
  • Shops use n000 and retain its 11 static items while adding 12 tokens. Actual command-card visibility of all added stock requires game verification.
  • Icon: this map inherits the Greater Mana Potion shop icon for this spell token. Its spell artwork is assigned to the model field (ifil), not the icon field (iico); the wiki displays the actual item icon.

What the valuation does not fully price

  • Consumable, spell purchase or information entry: purchase funds its effect/access; no permanent held-stat valuation.

  • Purge the Dead: cooldown 1 seconds; mana cost 0.

Effects, restrictions and script findings

Scripted effects: On an attack-start event by a hero carrying Forked Fury against a nonstructure, non-magic-immune target, rolls 1..16; 3,7,12,15 trigger (25%). Requires A0HZ cooldown expired. Proc casts ACfl forked lightning for 250 damage to up to 8 targets; 900 cast range, 945 maximum length, 400 maximum spread, 165 area field. Starts a 10-second A0HZ cooldown. Trigger uses EVENT_PLAYER_UNIT_ATTACKED, so proc does not require attack damage to land. Total acquisition cost: 1550 gold.

Scroll of Frenzy

I02P · Consumable
3,000gpurchase cost

Nearby eligible allies within 1000 gain +150% movement speed and +150% attack speed for 20 seconds. A separate effect heals eligible organic allies within 600 for 200 health. The activating ability also applies a caster Berserk with +200% movement speed, +300% attack speed and +10% damage taken for 30 seconds. These are separate native effects, not a promise that the bonuses add together. The scroll is removed on use.

No permanent carried stats are priced by this model. This item’s purchase buys its active effect, summon, spell access or information entry; zero stat subtotal does not mean zero gameplay value.

Core stats0gExpanded reference value0gUnallocated gold3,000gExpanded value / cost0%

Effects, restrictions and script findings

  • 1 charge(s).
  • Unholy Frenzy: cooldown 200 seconds; mana cost 0.
  • Gives living allied nonmechanical, nonstructure, non-magic-immune units within 1000 +150% movement speed and +150% attack speed for 20 seconds; damage-taken bonus is 0%.
  • Separately heals eligible allied organic units within 600 for 200 HP through a dummy item. No mana restoration.
  • Removes the scroll on cast, regardless of remaining displayed charges. Starts A07C cooldown for 25 seconds on the caster.

What the valuation does not fully price

  • Consumable, spell purchase or information entry: purchase funds its effect/access; no permanent held-stat valuation.
Original tooltip versus audited description

Corrected 1200 radius to 1000, 200% nearby attack speed to 150%, and three charges to one. Added separate caster effect and 200-health area heal.

Original

Casts a movement and attack speed buff on units around the caster that cannot be dispelled AoE: 1200 Attack Speed Bonus: 200% Movement Speed Bonus: 150% Duration: 20s Charges: 3

Audited description

Nearby eligible allies within 1000 gain +150% movement speed and +150% attack speed for 20 seconds. A separate effect heals eligible organic allies within 600 for 200 health. The activating ability also applies a caster Berserk with +200% movement speed, +300% attack speed and +10% damage taken for 30 seconds. These are separate native effects, not a promise that the bonuses add together. The scroll is removed on use. 1 charge(s). Unholy Frenzy: cooldown 200 seconds; mana cost 0. Scripted effects: Gives living allied nonmechanical, nonstructure, non-magic-immune units within 1000 +150% movement speed and +150% attack speed for 20 seconds; damage-taken bonus is 0%. Separately heals eligible allied organic units within 600 for 200 HP through a dummy item. No mana restoration. Removes the scroll on cast, regardless of remaining displayed charges. Starts A07C cooldown for 25 seconds on the caster.

6. Method, scope and limitations

  • Gold values are replacement-cost benchmarks inferred from shop prices, not a claim of balanced prices or actual purchase-cost allocation. There is no unique true price for each stat in a mixed item.
  • Every item has a row. Core stats and optional effect benchmarks are separated. Residual = purchase/complete crafting cost minus reference value; it is not an objective price for the remaining abilities. A negative residual means benchmark stats exceed price, not negative-priced spells.
  • Attribute values already represent the attribute bundle. Do not also count the health, mana, armor, attack speed, regeneration or primary-attribute damage supplied by STR/AGI/INT. Only separate item ability bonuses are added.
  • Percentages use percentage points: +20% attack speed is 20 × 12.5g. +125% mana regeneration is 125 × 0.4g, and is not +125 mana/sec. Flat mana/sec is a separate aura-derived benchmark.
  • Sobi Mask gives +50 mana alongside +125% regeneration. Its gross price is 0.8g per regeneration percentage point only if mana is ignored; subtracting 50g mana yields 0.4g. Neither rate is universal fair value.
  • Core subtotal excludes movement, procs, spell block, immunity, invisibility, healing casts and summon damage. Secondary lifesteal, evasion, cleave and aura benchmarks are optional comparisons; target restrictions, aura coverage, diminishing returns, uptime and stacking are not priced.
  • Recipe results use complete ingredient + scroll cost. Starting amulet costs 0g but has positive reference stats; replacing it is not the same as obtaining the entire result from nothing. Recipe-scroll rows value only their carried bonuses.
  • v41 baseline prices updated: STR 27.5g, attack speed 13.75g per percentage point, armor 23g, flat damage 13g, evasion 16g per point, cleave 15g per point. Armor uses (225−4×27.5)/5; Medaillon still implies 12.5g per armor.
  • v41 applies the requested item-price changes and Frosty damage/lifesteal nerfs on top of v40. Chaos Cloak rises by 500g in actual ingredient+recipe cost (3350g to 3850g); the old result object had a stale 3500g valuation. Other map archive members are preserved.
  • v44 hero cleave areas and damage ranks reflect the v43 range patch and v44 Myrmidon multiplier change. Other hero-state notes retain their earlier audit and have not been re-audited here. Item valuation remains based on unchanged v41 item data.

Verified map: FF799X_Rx_ItemBalance_v41.w3x

All 222 model entries are included. The 16 selected benchmark items reconstruct to their observed purchase prices. The v41 release applies the requested prices and Frosty damage/lifesteal changes to v40. All 1,333 unrelated archive members were preserved. Recipe totals and all 16 price benchmarks were checked. No live game playtest was performed.

Correction: the starting amulet’s actual movement bonus is +60, not the earlier +80 summary. Crafted amulets give +80. The item data and prices in this report reflect the v41 map release. Cleave areas and damage ranks reflect the v44 map; other hero-state notes retain their earlier audit.

Complete standalone HTML · 222 items · 16 benchmarks · six native/scripted cleave hero entries plus related area-attack findings. No JavaScript or external resources.
